case_number: Criminal Appeal No. 2501 of 2024 (arising out of SLP (Crl.) No. 6942 of 2024)
summary: Anticipatory bail maintainability while in judicial custody for another case; pre-condition under Section 438 CrPC requires 'reason to believe arrest may occur'; person already in custody cannot satisfy 'reason to believe may be arrested' requirement; conditions under Section 438(2)(i) cannot be fulfilled by detained person; regular bail remedy available via 'deemed custody' principle; High Court's position rejected, appeal allowed.
legal_provisions_cited: Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 s.18, s.18A(2)
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; anticipatory bail application declared non-maintainable for person already in judicial custody.
